pairs: “And to the Angel of the Church of Sardis write:
Hæc dicit qui habet septem spiritus Dei,
Thus says he who has the seven spirits of God
that you have a name which is alive,
and confirm the things that remain,
Non enim invenio opera tua plena coram Deo meo.
For I do not find your works to be full in the sight of my God.
In mente ergo habe qualiter acceperis,
keep in mind the way that you have received and heard,
and then observe it and repent.
But if you will not be vigilant,
I will come to you like a thief,
veniam ad te tamquam fur et nescies qua hora veniam ad te.
and you will not know at what hour I will come to you.
Sed habes pauca nomina in Sardis qui non inquinaverunt vestimenta sua:
But you have a few names in Sardis who have not defiled their garments.
And these shall walk with me in white,
so shall he be clothed in white vestments.
et non delebo nomen ejus de libro vitæ,
And I will not delete his name from the Book of Life.
et confitebor nomen ejus coram Patre meo,
And I will confess his name in the presence of my Father
and in the presence of his Angels.
let him hear what the Spirit says to the Churches.
And to the Angel of the Church of Philadelphia write:
Thus says the Holy One, the True One,
he who holds the key of David.
He opens and no one closes.
He closes and no one opens.
Ecce dedi coram te ostium apertum,
Behold, I have set an open door before you,
which no one is able to close.
and you have observed my word,
and you have not denied my name.
Ecce dabo de synagoga Satanæ, qui dicunt se Judæos esse,
Behold, I will take from the synagogue of Satan those who declare themselves to be Jews and are not,
ecce faciam illos ut veniant, et adorent ante pedes tuos:
I will cause them to approach and to reverence before your feet.
et scient quia ego dilexi te,
And they shall know that I have loved you.
Since you have kept the word of my patient endurance,
et ego servabo te ab hora tentationis,
I also will keep you from the hour of temptation,
quæ ventura est in orbem universum tentare habitantes in terra.
which shall overcome the whole world in order to test those living upon the earth.
Hold on to what you have,
so that no one may take your crown.
faciam illum columnam in templo Dei mei,
I will set him as a column in the temple of my God,
and he shall not depart from it anymore.
et scribam super eum nomen Dei mei,
And I will write upon him the name of my God,
et nomen civitatis Dei mei novæ Jerusalem,
and the name of the city of my God,
quæ descendit de cælo a Deo meo,
the new Jerusalem that descends out of heaven from my God,
let him hear what the Spirit says to the Churches.
And to the Angel of the Church of Laodicea write:
who is the Beginning of the creation of God:
I wish that you were either cold
incipiam te evomere ex ore meo:
I will begin to vomit you out of my mouth.
and I have been enriched further,
and I have need of nothing.’
et nescis quia tu es miser,
And you do not know that you are wretched,
Suadeo tibi emere a me aurum ignitum probatum,
I urge you to buy from me gold, tested by fire,
ut locuples fias, et vestimentis albis induaris,
so that you may be enriched and may be clothed in white vestments,
et non appareat confusio nuditatis tuæ,
and so that the shame of your nakedness may disappear.
et collyrio inunge oculos tuos ut videas.
And anoint your eyes with an eye salve, so that you may see.
Therefore, be zealous and do penance.
Ecce sto ad ostium, et pulso:
Behold, I stand at the door and knock.
si quis audierit vocem meam, et aperuerit mihi januam,
If anyone will hear my voice and will open the door to me,
and I will dine with him,
dabo ei sedere mecum in throno meo:
I will grant to him to sit with me on my throne,
just as I also have overcome
et sedi cum Patre meo in throno ejus.
and have sat down with my Father on his throne.
let him hear what the Spirit says to the Churches.”
